Food, farm work and return dates limit service.

Variants.Content: Woods and Rhine crossings support warnings and ambush. Assembly removes farm labor; how long followers remain depends on food and return dates as well as commands.

Woods and Rhine crossings support warning and ambush. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Food, farm work and return dates limit service.
Food, farm work and return dates limit service. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Woods and Rhine crossings support warning and ambush.
Woods and Rhine crossings support warning and ambush. Fighters come from households; prolonged loss of labor or animals weakens the next levy. Food, farm work and return dates limit service.
Food, farm work and return dates limit service. Repair, carrying and care also use people, while daily supply continues after troops pass. Woods and Rhine crossings support warning and ambush.
